QuestInfo.name: The General Store of Perion
QuestInfo.0: Ayan wanted you to bring the Tree Branches to...someone. Maybe you should ask her again.
QuestInfo.1: Ayan told you to take your Tree Branches to Sophia at the General Store. Follow the arrow signs to the General Store tent to meet Sophia.
QuestInfo.2: You gave Tree Branches to Sophia. Good work. #bReturn to Ayan.#k

0.0: Now, I want you to take these Tree Branches to the people who need them. Sophia at the General Store asked for a bunch, so take them to her. You should introduce yourself while you're there.

yes.0: Follow the arrow signs to the General Store tent. Introduce yourself to Sophia and her uncle, and give her these Tree Branches.

1.0: Hi, #h0#! Ayan said you were coming. Do you have Tree Branches for us?

yes.0: Great, thank you! My uncle's been pestering me about getting him some new back-scratchers. These will be perfect. Oh, sorry, but I need to get back to work. Please thank #bAyan#k for me. See you around!

item.0: No Tree Branches? I know Ayan asked you to deliver some...you better get this sorted out, before she gets mad...

lost.0: Hey. You lost the Tree Branches I gave you, didn't you? Here, I found them. Take them where I told you, and DON'T make me tell you again.
